title: Palace of Sultan Mas'ud III

terrainReference.basis: Original local ground at the centre of the named site envelope.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap archaeological extent and overlapping mapped ruined fabric, corroborated by the Italian Archaeological Mission site description.
mapIdentity.scope: The June 2010 Ghazni archaeological site, with scattered low walls, the footprint of the excavated open court and the small later domed shrine above the western iwan.

note: The two mapped archaeological outlines bound the plan. The excavators’ published 42 by 20 metre open court sets the proportions. The distant image and the unchanged original terrain control approximate remnant heights and relative grades.
